name: Captain's Farewell
source:
What would you write if you had time for only a few lines? Would you reveal the things left unsaid? A pirate captain writes her last words in a letter during a decisive battle. 

[From [url=https://ebbasuke.itch.io/captains-farewell]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
如果只来得及写下寥寥数行，你会写些什么？你会倾诉那些从未说出口的话吗？在一场决定胜负的战斗中，一位女海盗船长将最后的话语写进信里。

[摘自[url=https://ebbasuke.itch.io/captains-farewell]itch.io[/url]]
